WITH monthly_po AS (
         SELECT purchasing_fact.po_month,
            count(DISTINCT purchasing_fact.purchaseorderid) AS total_purchase_orders,
            sum(purchasing_fact.subtotal) AS total_po_spend
           FROM analytics.purchasing_fact
          GROUP BY purchasing_fact.po_month
        )
 SELECT po_month,
    total_purchase_orders,
    total_po_spend,
    round((((total_po_spend - lag(total_po_spend) OVER (ORDER BY po_month)) * 100.0) / NULLIF(lag(total_po_spend) OVER (ORDER BY po_month), (0)::numeric)), 2) AS mom_spend_growth_pct
   FROM monthly_po
  ORDER BY po_month;
